gloss: slip of the tongue; verbal mistake

definitions.gloss: slip of the tongue; saying something incorrectly by mistake
definitions.explanation: accidentally saying the wrong word or mispronouncing something

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{間違|まちが}いをした。
examples.english: I made a slip of the tongue.

examples.japanese: それは{言|い}い{間違|まちが}いです。
{緊張|きんちょう}して{言|い}い{間違|まちが}いが{多|おお}くなった。
examples.english: I got nervous and made many slips of the tongue.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い combines {言|い}う (to say) + {間違|まちが}い (mistake).

COMMON CAUSES:
- {緊張|きんちょう} - nervousness
- {疲|つか}れ - fatigue
- {急|いそ}いでいる - being in a hurry
- {似|に}た{言葉|ことば} - similar-sounding words

TYPES:
- {名前|なまえ}の{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い - mixing up names
- {数字|すうじ}の{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い - saying wrong numbers
- {敬語|けいご}の{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い - keigo mistakes

RELATED ～{間違|まちが}い WORDS:
- {聞|き}き{間違|まちが}い - mishearing
- {書|か}き{間違|まちが}い - writing mistake
- {読|よ}み{間違|まちが}い - misreading

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {言|い}い{損|そこ}ない - saying something wrong
- {舌|した}がもつれる - tongue getting tangled
